scope: Historical world-6 room/cell ordering and attachment projection only; excludes structural/damage migration, world-save publication, live clearance, and current endpoint authoring.

rng_authority.algorithm: RandomNumberGenerator seeded integer stream used by the pinned GDScript closure
rng_authority.compatibility_rule: A newer engine is accepted only when focused comparison reproduces pinned historical outputs.

copied_algorithm_subset.template_selection: Legacy first-three pool without generation context; exact ordered fourteen-template pool when persisted difficulty is nonempty.
copied_algorithm_subset.room_assignment: Zone order, count RNG, normalized weighted role selection, duplicate cap, guarantees, and footprint RNG.
copied_algorithm_subset.cell_layout: Room placement, connector realization, discovered cardinal/vertical adjacency, and connectivity selection needed before attachment projection.

retry_policy.selection: first connected candidate, otherwise final nonempty best effort

copied_algorithm_subset.serialization_subset: Placed room id, role, deck, and ordered cells mapped to [x*4.0, deck*4.0, z*4.0].

native_v2.rule: Use only the already-registered class after exact platform binary hash and generator-version validation. Never install, copy, or load a duplicate extension.

dock_edges.source: world-6 WorldSnapshot.dock_edges rows relevant to this owner

room_cell_markers.source: closed world-6 combat/objective records whose schemas identify room_id and topology-local cell

witness_schema.excluded: No route hint or corrected-current geometry may be inferred or supplied as a witness.

fallback_archetype.name: Derelict
fallback_archetype.description: Dead ship shell — randomized exploration space with dock for life boat attachment

data.description: Linear corridor backbone. Bridge forward, engineering aft, airlock lateral entry. Classic submarine layout.
Y-fork: bridge forward, junction splits port (cargo/engineering) and starboard (crew/medical), engineering aft.
Two decks connected by ramp. Upper deck: bridge forward, crew areas. Lower deck: cargo, engineering aft, reactor.

Three-deck vertical with an auxiliary service deck between the main upper and lower decks. Bridge on top, service deck middle, reactor at the bottom. Tests multi-deck traversal and three vertical transitions.
Single-deck minimal freighter with very tight corridors. Bridge forward, engineering aft, airlock lateral entry. Uses small role footprints; intended as the LIFE_BOAT-adjacent small variant.
Wide single-deck layout where rooms spread out laterally rather than along a spine. Bridge forward-center, cargo starboard, medical port, engineering aft. Tests lateral-spread topology.
Derelict variant A — dock + compartments with one biomatter blockage on a non-critical side link. Player enters via the dock and explores compartments.
Derelict variant B — dock + compartments + sealed forward chamber with a high-value cache. Sealed chamber is reachable but blocked by a biomatter blockage the player must clear.
Closed loop corridor with central core rooms. Player can circle the ship; critical path uses the ring then breaks into the core.
Hub-and-spoke: central junction with 3–4 wings (bridge, cargo, medical, engineering). High branching variety.
Two parallel corridor spines linked by cross-passages. Redundant routes for salvage under threat pressure.
Forward hangar/dock volume with side maintenance and aft engineering. Emphasizes large cargo/dock rooms.
Deep-core vault: long choke corridor into nested secure compartments. High threat pressure on the approach.
Hive cluster — short corridor core with clustered compartments, one lateral overgrown pocket, destination on the bow. Occupancy topology only; biomatter kit remaps existing stems.
